correctness.rationale: The exact source coordinates satisfy the elliptic-curve equation. At degree-one good primes above \(17\) and \(23\), the critical value reduces to points of exact orders \(9\) and \(4\). Good-reduction injectivity on prime-to-residue-character torsion makes a hypothetical torsion order simultaneously of the forms \(9\cdot17^a\) and \(4\cdot23^b\), which is impossible. The free \(\mathbf Z[\zeta_3]\)-module and pairwise-difference assertions then follow because every nonzero elliptic-curve endomorphism has finite kernel. The fixed subgroup has order three because \(\deg(\rho-1)=3\).

value.rationale: The arithmetic position of the critical values is a natural structural invariant of the newly explicit genus-19 Albanese fibration. The result separates the singular-fiber orbit, which generates a non-torsion rank-two CM lattice, from the smooth symmetry-invariant fiber values, which form a three-torsion subgroup. This distinction is useful for monodromy and arithmetic study of the fibration and is not a routine coordinate simplification.
